info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Sessions API
Microsoft Windows 10 Initialize a media capture session

items.docs: Initializes a MediaCapture session with specified settings using MediaCapture.InitializeAsync. The MediaCaptureInitializationSettings specify the video and audio device, streaming category, and sharing mode.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Create an evaluation session

items.docs: Creates a LearningModelSession for evaluating a loaded model. The session binds the model to a LearningModelDevice (CPU, DirectX, or DirectXHighPerformance) for hardware-accelerated inference.
